crossRefs.note: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
Yahweh said to Moses, “When you go back into Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in…
Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.
O Yahweh, why do you make us wander from your ways, and harden our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’…
saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see…
For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they…
But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath…
Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no…
But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

translations.web: Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also, and he didn’t let the people go.
translations.bsb: But Pharaoh hardened his heart this time as well, and he would not let the people go.
translations.kjv: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.
translations.asv: And Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also, and he did not let the people go.
